topic: Space collections: migration re-embeds, and per-collection overhead is unmeasured
detail: MigrateHybrid copies space collections the way it copies the base, re-chunking and re-embedding them, though they are hybrid already; a raw copy of points with their vectors (which SP-071's retag needs anyway) would avoid the embedding cost. Each space collection has its own segments and HNSW index; memory and disk per collection with several spaces were not measured (SP-002 measured latency and relabel only). A space collection removed outside orchd stays in orchd's list until restart (reads treat it as empty).
